tagline: Everything you find, kept in one place
brief: A personal library, built on your own Mac, for the posts, reels, threads and pages you want to keep. Share from your iPhone; your Mac downloads, transcribes and files it. Private, calm and searchable.
criteria: Distinct from social-app and bookmark icons, readable at 16 px in the menu bar, works in one colour, feels like a collector's treasure shelf.

concepts.name: The Pair
concepts.idea: Two bookmark birds, one behind the other: a collection, with a sparkle for the shiny thing a magpie would keep.
rationale: A bookmark that is also a magpie says keep and collect in one shape
Real transparent gap, so it works as a one-colour menu-bar icon
The sparkle is the bird's eye and the dot of the i

recommendation: The Pair with the bold wordmark (option D).
next_steps: Refine the letterforms by hand in Figma or Illustrator
Use symbol-small.svg for the menu bar and anything under 24 px
